question: What is the cancellation rate by product category? Show categories with at least 20 orders.
agent_sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(ct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_orders,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cancellation_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
GROUP BY category
HAVING total_orders >= 20
ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC
raw_llm_sql:
SELECT 
    t.product_category_name_english AS category,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(o.order_id) AS cancellation_rate,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 20
ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC;
gold_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(ct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 20
ORDER BY cancel_rate_pct DESC

question: For each customer state, what is the average order value and average review score?
agent_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.price) AS order_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
),
order_reviews_agg AS (
    SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM order_reviews
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_state,
    AVG(ot.order_value) AS avg_order_value,
    AVG(ora.avg_review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_totals ot ON o.order_id = ot.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_reviews_agg ora ON o.order_id = ora.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY c.customer_state;
raw_llm_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_state,
    AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_order_value,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN 
    order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state;
gold_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(ov.order_total), 2) AS avg_order_value,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS order_total
  FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id
) ov ON o.order_id = ov.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: What is the month-over-month order count growth rate for 2018?
agent_sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) = '2018'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
    month,
    order_count,
    LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_order_count,
    (CAST(order_count AS REAL) - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM monthly_orders
ORDER BY month;
raw_llm_sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month,
        COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
    GROUP BY order_month
),
growth_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        order_month,
        order_count,
        LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY order_month) AS prev_month_count
    FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
    order_month,
    order_count,
    prev_month_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_month_count IS NULL OR prev_month_count = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(order_count - prev_month_count AS REAL) / prev_month_count
    END AS growth_rate
FROM growth_calc;
gold_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) = '2018'
  GROUP BY month
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT month, cnt,
         LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_cnt
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, cnt, prev_cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * (cnt - prev_cnt) / prev_cnt, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM with_lag
WHERE prev_cnt IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month

question: Which sellers have the highest percentage of 5-star reviews, among those with at least 30 reviews?
agent_sql:
SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    COUNT(r.review_score) AS total_reviews,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_star_reviews,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_score)) AS percentage_5_star
FROM order_items oi
JOIN order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(r.review_score) >= 30
ORDER BY percentage_5_star DESC;
raw_llm_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_id
FROM sellers s
JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(orv.review_id) >= 30
ORDER BY CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN orv.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(orv.review_id) DESC, 
         s.seller_id ASC
LIMIT 1;
gold_sql:
SELECT oi.seller_id,
       COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_star,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_five_star
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY pct_five_star DESC
LIMIT 10

question: What is the average time between order approval and carrier pickup, in hours, by seller state?
agent_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_state,
    AVG((julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) * 24) AS avg_hours_to_carrier
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
  AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY avg_hours_to_carrier ASC;
raw_llm_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_state,
    AVG(
        (julianday(o.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) * 24
    ) AS avg_time_to_carrier_hours
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE 
    o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
    AND o.shipping_limit_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    s.seller_state;
gold_sql:
SELECT s.seller_state,
       ROUND(AVG(
         (julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) * 24
       ), 2) AS avg_hours_to_ship
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY avg_hours_to_ship

raw_llm_sql:
SELECT 
    t.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
gold_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(ct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
